inflight_policy: Stop scheduling at the CPU threshold; at most eight already-running pairs finish under the 120-second child timeout. Report their actual additional CPU.
forecast: Linear pilot extrapolation gives about 26.76 child CPU hours and 5 wall hours at ideal eight-worker scaling. These are forecasts, not full measurements. Actual duplicate rates and host contention can change yield and time.
previous_campaign: Legacy 500-node three-PV data was stopped before any decisive neural test. Its journals and partial preparation remain diagnostic. No prior failed or incomplete result is relabeled as a full pass.
